title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Types of Livestock Products) Under Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the "Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Livestock Fund" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), "livestock products as defined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs" refers to meat, horns, milk, honey, and eggs produced from animals such as sheep (including goats), deer, bees, ducks, rabbits, turkeys, geese, chickens, and pheasants, as specified in the Act. <Amended March 23, 2013>
